Cooking is great fun for children, but remember to talk to them about how to stay safe in the kitchen. Adults should always supervise children when cooking.

Safety rules might include:

  • Always ask an adult before you cook.
  • Ask an adult if you need boiling water or a hot oven.
  • Ask an adult to supervise when you use a knife.
  • Move carefully in the kitchen - don't run around.
  • Wipe up any spills straight away so noone slips.

Hygiene rules might include:

  • Wash your hands with soap and water.
  • Wipe down work surfaces before you start.
  • Tie back long hair and wear and apron if you have one.
  • If you lick your fingers, wash your hands again.
  • Keep cooked and uncooked food separate. Be especially careful with raw meat and fish.
  • Ask an adult to check everything is properly cooked before you eat it.

text:
Do some baking together! It can be anything you like as long as you are measuring the mass of the ingredients together.

Stuck for ideas? Try these easy rock buns!

100g margarine/butter
200g self-raising flour
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp baking powder
85g soft brown sugar
100g sultanas
1 egg


Recipe:

1. Heat oven to 180°C/160°C fan/gas mark 4.
2. Grease a baking tray.
3. Mix the flour, baking powder and cinnamon in a bowl. Add the butter/margarine and rub into the mixture until you have something that looks like fine breadcrumbs.
4. Stir in the fruit and sugar and then add the milk and egg.
5. Mix to a firm dough.
6. Spoon 10 rough blobs of the mixture onto the baking tray, leaving some room in between for spreading whilst cooking.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
